meta.title: Acme Health: migration scope dispute
meta.summary: Sales promised a 5-year history migration, but the signed SOW covers 2 years. The client finds out at go-live week.

sources.subject: Follow-up from today's demo
sources.author: Jake Morris (Sales)
sources.body: Hi Rebecca, great session today. To recap: Brightdesk will migrate your full patient-engagement history (all 5 years) from LegacyCRM, and HL7 feeds are supported out of the box. Implementation in 8 weeks. Proposal attached.

sources.subject: Re: Follow-up from today's demo
sources.author: Rebecca Chen (Acme Health)
sources.body: Thanks Jake. The full 5-year history is critical for our compliance reporting, so glad that's covered. We'll review the SOW.

sources.author: Jake Morris
sources.body: Acme Health SOW going out today, standard implementation package. Can we get it signed before quarter end?

sources.author: Olivia Grant (Deal Desk)
sources.body: Standard package = 24 months of history + CSV import only, no HL7. If they need more it's the Enterprise migration add-on. Are you sure that's what they agreed to?

sources.author: Jake Morris
sources.body: yeah they're fine, we can sort out the details in implementation

sources.subject: Acme Health implementation
sources.author: Olivia Grant (Deal Desk)
sources.body: SOW signed. Scope: standard implementation, 24-month history migration from LegacyCRM via CSV, go-live target Sept 30. Assigning to Ana Silva.

sources.author: Ana Silva (Implementation)
sources.body: Kickoff done with Rebecca and her IT lead Marcus. Data extract from LegacyCRM requested. Next milestone: test import by Aug 29.

sources.subject: Weekly update
sources.author: Ana Silva (Implementation)
sources.body: Hi Rebecca, test import of the 24-month dataset completed: 1.2M records, 99.7% matched. On track for go-live Sept 30.

sources.subject: Re: Weekly update
sources.author: Marcus Webb (Acme Health IT)
sources.body: Ana, why 24 months? We sent the full 5-year extract. Also when do we set up the HL7 feed from our EHR?

sources.author: Ana Silva
sources.body: @jake Acme Health think they're getting 5 years of history + HL7. SOW says 24 months CSV. Did we promise them more?

sources.author: Jake Morris
sources.body: I might have mentioned the full history in the demo. Can we just do it? It's the same import.

sources.author: Ana Silva
sources.body: Not the same: 5 years is ~4x volume and the pre-2023 data is in a different schema. HL7 is a separate integration project. That's 3–4 extra weeks minimum.

sources.subject: Re: Weekly update
sources.author: Ana Silva (Implementation)
sources.body: Hi Marcus, the signed SOW covers 24 months via CSV. I'm checking with our team on the 5-year history and HL7 and will come back to you by Friday.

sources.author: Ana Silva (Implementation)
sources.body: Scope question still open with sales. Client expects 5y history + HL7. Blocked on decision; go-live at risk.

sources.subject: We were promised the full history
sources.author: Rebecca Chen (Acme Health)
sources.body: Jake, your email of July 14 says Brightdesk will migrate all 5 years and HL7 is supported out of the box. Your implementation team now says that's not in scope. We were also promised an answer by Sept 5 and haven't heard anything. Go-live is in two weeks. What is going on?

sources.author: Lisa Park (VP Customer Success)
sources.body: Acme Health is escalating about migration scope. Jake, Ana, I need the history here: what was said in the sale vs. what's in the SOW.

sources.author: Olivia Grant (Deal Desk)
sources.body: For the record I flagged on July 21 that standard = 24 months, no HL7.

sources.subject: Re: We were promised the full history
sources.author: Lisa Park (VP Customer Success)
sources.body: Rebecca, you're right that our July 14 email set a different expectation than the SOW, and that's on us. We will migrate the full 5-year history at no extra cost, with go-live moved to Oct 21. HL7 we'll scope as a phase 2 with a firm plan by Sept 26.

sources.author: Ana Silva (Implementation)
sources.body: Scope change approved by Lisa: 5y history at no cost, go-live Oct 21. HL7 phase 2 plan due Sept 26.

sources.author: Ana Silva (Implementation)
sources.body: HL7 phase 2 plan sent to Rebecca and Marcus: 6-week integration starting Nov 2. 5y migration test import passed (4.6M records).
